clues.fortune_text: After a long day of Work, Love is near: one slot below Work, Love's verses appear.
clues.nudge: Read past the rhyme. The couplet names two phrase banks and says which one is lower. Slot 1 is at the top.

clues.fortune_text: A seagull drops a clam from just above the rocks. Wisdom drops in the same way: one slot above Luck.
clues.nudge: The gull is a picture of something falling from a little way up. The second sentence names two phrase banks. Slot 1 is at the top.

clues.fortune_text: Work's slot is the FSF's number for the freedom to study how a program works (the FSF counts from 0).
clues.nudge: The Free Software Foundation lists four freedoms and numbers them itself, starting at 0. Use the FSF's number, not your own count.

clues.fortune_text: The gnu's Caesar note, each letter shifted 3 along: Oxfn lv lq vorw ilyh.
clues.nudge: A Caesar shift moves every letter the same number of places along the alphabet. Move each letter 3 places back to undo it: D becomes A, E becomes B.

clues.fortune_text: assert(slot[TRAVEL] == slot[LOVE] + 1); /* slot 1 is the top, +1 is below */
clues.nudge: slot[X] means the number of the slot that bank X feeds. An assert must be true, so read the line as plain arithmetic about two slot numbers.

clues.fortune_text: Ribbon cable, wire 1 at the top: the Wisdom wire is the one just below the Travel wire.
clues.nudge: A ribbon cable is a flat row of wires numbered in order, so neighbouring wires differ by one. Each wire number is a slot number.
